summary: Local-first Chrome extension that scrolls through a complete web page, stabilizes changing presentation, stitches captured frames in the browser, and opens a measured workspace for non-destructive annotation and original-resolution PNG export.

summary: Recovering a failed Vercel rollout by separating a correct feature change from build-system failures, hardening the production build, and verifying the deployed widget contract end to end.

scope: Next.js build reliability, dependency compatibility, and Vercel delivery
problem: The SupportKori integration was correct in source and merged to main, but Book Heaven's Vercel production deployment failed before the new build reached visitors. The live site therefore looked as if the widget change were missing, even though the actual fault was in the delivery path. constraints: The large Next.js application compiles many routes and integrations inside Vercel's finite build-memory envelope; the default Node.js heap was exhausted during production validation.

summary: Builds or audits Android applications from existing web products with explicit feature traceability and platform-aware parity.

constraints: Every web capability needs an explicit Android disposition and evidence trail.

Deferred and unsupported capabilities must remain visible rather than disappearing from scope.

summary: Deploys a verified local build artifact to Netlify without asking Netlify to rebuild the source project.
role: Agent workflow design and automation engineering
scope: Deployment, deterministic validation, and portable distribution
problem: Deploying an already-built application through a source-oriented hosting flow can trigger unnecessary rebuilds, publish the wrong directory, or upload unsafe local artifacts.
constraints: The requested artifact must be validated before any remote mutation.
Secrets, source trees, caches, and unrelated files must never enter the deploy payload.
Site selection, production promotion, and deployment are separate authorization boundaries.

architecture.summary: Local artifact and publish-directory preflight; Netlify CLI flow selection with explicit mutation gates; deployed URL and content verification.

layers.title: Preflight

layers.title: Deployment

layers.title: Verification

decisions.title: Deploy the artifact, not the repository
decisions.detail: Keep prebuilt delivery separate from source builds and their dependency graph.

decisions.title: Block unsafe trees before login
decisions.detail: Run local safety checks before requesting credentials or mutating remote state.

decisions.title: Verify the public result
decisions.detail: Treat a successful CLI exit as incomplete until deployment state and served content are checked.

contribution: Defined safe artifact-tree acceptance rules.
Implemented a deterministic preflight utility.
Separated draft, production, and site-selection authorization.
Added package and deployment-flow regression tests.
outcomes: Agents can deploy a verified local build without asking Netlify to rebuild source.
Unsafe payloads fail before remote changes.
Authorization remains scoped to the requested deployment stage.
The final report distinguishes local validation, mutation, and public verification.
